parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Wallpaper/Tests/WallpaperTests/QualitySignalTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.75 indicates structural near-duplication, the two methods — `recoveryMagnitudeRapidCooling` (line 206) and `recoveryScaleAcceleratesRecovery` (line 223) — are distinct test cases exercising different behavioural scenarios of the same quality-signal domain (rapid cooling vs. accelerating recovery scale). Test methods with similar shapes but different semantic intent are intentional; collapsing them would obscure test coverage and make failure diagnosis harder.
